name: VHS Tracking
desc: Worn videotape overlay — a bright tracking band with torn offset stripes slowly climbing the frame, magenta/cyan chroma fringing at the edges, occasional jitter slices, sparse static sparkle, gently drifting scanline shade (strobe-safe), and a flickering PLAY/timestamp OSD. Styles: worn, near-mint, badly damaged, haunted-tape with a pale drifting aura, and rewind with fast bands.
